svg.text: TCG Credential Activation + ACME device-attest-01 + mTLS
• AK: Restricted signing, bound to EK via MakeCredential
• TPM2_Certify proves Agent Key attributes + binding to AK
• ACME device-attest-01 verifies full chain: EK→AK→Agent
1. Client: TPM2_Create(Agent Key) → flexible signing, FixedTPM
3. Client: Build WebAuthn TPM attestation object (fmt="tpm")
4. Server: Validate LAK cert chain (pki-ak CA)
5. Server: Verify TPM2_Certify signature with AK public key
7. ACME: Issue Agent certificate for CSR signed by Agent Key
